name: Black Dungeon: Draw A Card
detailed_description:
Black Dungeon: Draw A Card is a pixel-style action game combining rogue-like dungeon exploration, card drawing, and real-time combat.

You play as a lowly scroll-binder, accidentally dragged into the Devourer Dungeon. By drawing and casting powerful skill cards, you’ll battle fierce enemies, strengthen your deck, and eventually confront the final boss.

Each card is a tactical decision—Fireball, Toxic Mist, Meteoric, even hidden cards. You’ll need to master combos, invincibility rolls, shields, and rage boosts to survive intense battles across maze-like rooms.

The game supports mouse and keyboard controls. Cards are played via drag-and-drop, blending strategy with smooth, responsive action. Every interaction features dynamic effects. With camera shakes triggered by attacks, hits, and boss skills, each strike feels impactful.

Randomly generated dungeon layouts, enemy groups, and treasure rewards ensure high replay-ability. As you progress, enemies grow stronger, and the stakes rise with every level—beating it once is just the beginning.

Clear the dungeon three times in a row, and you might even unlock secret content…？

With crisp UI, juicy animations, and immersive BGM sets for every stage—from entering the dungeon to defeating the boss—this visually rich, mechanically polished game is 100% free!

short_description: Once a lowly servant of the Arcane Illustration Society, you triggered a portal while reading the forbidden Codex Obscura and were cast into the Devourer Dungeon. Branded by its core, you gained scrollbinding powers. Explore, collect lost cards, and seal the Demon Devourer: Taotie.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD HD 7850 (DirectX 10 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended resolution: 1280x720 or higher
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced at 1920x1080 resolution. SSD recommended for smoother load times
